profile.name: Linhan Pang
profile.affiliation: School of Computer Science, Shanghai Jiao Tong University

paragraphs: I am a second-year undergraduate studying Computer Science and Technology at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. My interests lie in machine learning, particularly deep learning and reinforcement learning.

I am a co-author of AmbiHTMLBench, a benchmark for image-to-HTML reconstruction of heterogeneous documents, submitted to ICLR 2027 on September 26, 2026. My contributions include data collection, quality control, and experimental software.

I bring enthusiasm and a careful, methodical approach to research. I am willing to invest the time and effort needed to do the work well, take responsibility for the tasks entrusted to me, and follow through with close attention to detail. I welcome opportunities to collaborate with academic labs and industry teams, and am seeking research and internship opportunities where I can contribute and learn.

education.description: Undergraduate studies, School of Computer Science.

researchInterests.title: Machine Learning and Deep Learning
researchInterests.description: I am interested in representation learning and how neural networks generalize to new tasks. Topics I would like to explore include model architectures, optimization, and evaluation, with an emphasis on data quality and reproducibility.

researchInterests.title: Reinforcement Learning
researchInterests.description: I am interested in how agents learn to make decisions through interaction with their environment. I would like to explore exploration strategies, policy learning, and sample efficiency, particularly in autonomous systems and decision-making under uncertainty.

projects.title: AmbiHTMLBench: A Multidimensional Benchmark for Image-to-HTML Reconstruction of Heterogeneous Documents
projects.description: A multidimensional benchmark for reconstructing heterogeneous documents in HTML from images. My contributions include data collection and organization, quality checks, and the design of parts of the experimental software framework.

projects.title: Summer Research Placement
projects.description: I worked on algorithm design and implementation, system deployment, and simulation testing, and prepared technical reports on the project.
